title: A 247-state Turing machine for ZFC consistency
prepared_for: Vladimir Reshetnikov and the ProveIt project

claim.statement: ZFC proves that nonhalting of the exact blank-tape machine is equivalent to Con(ZFC).
claim.proof_method: Ordinary mathematical proof: universal register identities, exhaustive finite symbolic instruction certificates, a complete blank bootstrap, whole-frame induction, and identified inherited native/ZF/ZFC calibration.
claim.independent_review_scope: Separately implemented automated checks and a separate automated mathematical review within this investigation; not external peer review.

machine.halting_semantics: Execute the final write and move into the separate halt label; subsequent execution is absorbing.
